records.purpose: Accept the exact current broker/offer/generation with a nonzero owner/session idempotency key. Duplicate identical requests return the original handle without another effect; changed input with the same key is BAD_ARG. At most 64 retained acceptance receipts per session; no eviction.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*accept)(sco_plugin* self, const sc_mission_offer* offer, uint64_t key, uint64_t* out_mission);`
Accept the exact current broker/offer/generation with a nonzero owner/session idempotency key. Duplicate identical requests return the original handle without another effect; changed input with the same key is BAD_ARG. At most 64 retained acceptance receipts per session; no eviction.
records.ownership: Caller-owned copied buffers; no allocation transfer. Mutations scoped to live plugin and current offline session.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; WRONG_THREAD before backend access.
records.callback_context: Backend callbacks synchronous on game thread; pointers valid only during call.
records.reentrancy: Recursive calls and Stop/replacement during callbacks refused (FAILED).
records.results: OK on success; BAD_ARG invalid/short input or released handle; UNAVAILABLE absent backend/unsafe admission; NOT_FOUND unknown IDs; TOO_MANY bounded quota; FAILED refused progression/provider failure; CRASHED latches restart required. Outputs untouched on failure.
records.absent_capability: Missing table: query_service NOT_FOUND; absent method/backend or unsafe admission: UNAVAILABLE.
records.cleanup: Consumers unload before Stop. Released owners lose mutation authority. No automatic persistence or replay of uncertain effects. Native faults permanently close admission until process restart.
limitations: No validated Windows engine adapter; synthetic/compile checked, not run in game.
Uniform phase widths only; other mission kinds unavailable.
No persistent receipt/store/import policy in game pack.
